walls.note: Lettered face: the pane with NOOIT MEER AUSCHWITZ and the shattered plate in front (Commons FaceMePLS, Maussen).

items.where: upright pane of clear glass about 3.3 x 1.85 m standing on the gravel, in two steel shoes
items.how: builder: thin glass box on two frame-coloured shoes; thickness and exact size estimated

items.where: NOOIT MEER / AUSCHWITZ cut into the pane in outline capitals (two lines, about 0.35 m high)
items.how: builder: raised stroke-font capitals (letterBoxes) in pale accent; the real letters are cut outlines in the glass

items.where: two shattered mirror plates laid flat in steel trays in front of the pane, cracked into shards
items.how: builder: tray box, glass slab and 14 thin dark crack boxes radiating from an impact point per plate; real shard pattern not copied

items.where: gravel bed round the pane and plates, framed by park planting

walls.note: Back of the pane: the cut letters read mirrored through the glass; not separately modelled.
Edge of the pane and the bed: not photographed.

sources.name: Gus Maussen, Auschwitz Monument Jan Wolkers
